name: Anjou Mai
source:
Mai enjoys staying up-to-date on the latest fashion trends. She decided not to join any clubs or other extracurricular activities in order to maximize her free time. After school, she can be found chatting with [url=/c98238]Yuki[/url], or hanging out at the shopping district. Though she cherishes Yuki, who adores her like a big sister, she also often teases her.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
